prompt: Which stores took no orders in February 2025? order_ts holds UTC time: count orders from 1 February 2025 to 28 February 2025, UTC days, both included. Return store_code, one row for each such store. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT s.store_code
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_id IS NULL

SELECT s.store_code
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

SELECT s.store_code
FROM stores s
JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.store_code
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
WHERE o.order_id IS NOT NULL
